subject: Follow-up: Next steps & rotating demo slots
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Next steps & rotating demo slots

Hi Jordan —

Great to meet you and the Acme team today. Quick recap & proposed next steps:

- Recap: You’re focused on predictable latency for customer-facing assistants and reducing per-token inference cost for peak hours.
- Next step: technical deep-dive + demo where we can show a live inference run and discuss model/quantization trade-offs.

To make scheduling straightforward across your US/EU/APAC stakeholders, I wanted to propose an approach that worked well for us with other global teams: a rotating set of demo slots so no one team always has to take the 6am meeting. Below are proposed rotating slots (we’ll rotate weekly):

Option A (US-friendly week):
- Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST (great for US and early EU overlap)

Option B (EU-friendly week):
- Thu 15:00 BST / 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT (better for EU mornings and US late mornings)

Option C (APAC-friendly week):
- Wed 08:30 SGT / 01:30 BST / Tue 20:30 PT (morning for APAC, late evening for US)

If those look reasonable, I’ll send a week-by-week rotating schedule and an invite. I’ve attached a brief demo agenda and a draft mutual action plan so you can share internally.

Would you prefer we pick one slot that works for the core team and rotate weekly, or start with two alternating weeks (US/EU) and add APAC as-needed?

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Demo-Agenda.pdf (1 page), Mutual-Action-Plan-ACME.xlsx (stub)

Hi Camila —

Thanks for the clear recap. The team appreciated the call. A few quick notes from our side:

- We definitely want the rotating approach — it’s important our EU product folks see the demo live.
- PM lead (Anita) would prefer EU-morning slots; SRE/infra people are mostly US-based and prefer late-morning ET.
- APAC (Tokyo/Singapore) needs either a morning SGT slot or an occasional session recorded — they can attend once every 3 weeks in the APAC-friendly slot.

For next week the core group is available Tue 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST — so Option A would work. Please include the SRE lead (Iccar Lee) if possible — Iccar’s email is iccar.lee@acme.com.

Jordan Smith
Head of Product, Acme Corp

Jordan / Camila —

Looping in Aditya to coordinate capacity and to help with the invite cadence. Camila — I recommend we do a weekly rotation on the pattern below which keeps the core demo content identical and surfaces any region-specific infra questions to the right engineers. Proposed weekly rotation (example first 6 weeks):

Week 1: US-friendly (Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET / 18:00 BST) — core product + infra overview (SRE joined)
Week 2: EU-friendly (Thu 15:00 BST / 10:00 ET / 07:00 PT) — product + customer success use-cases
Week 3: APAC-friendly (Wed 08:30 SGT / 01:30 BST / Tue 20:30 PT) — include APAC PMs, record for replay
Week 4: US-friendly (repeat)
Week 5: EU-friendly
Week 6: APAC-friendly

We’ll send calendar invites that mark these as rotating demo slots and include a recurring weekly series. If a given week’s slot is not needed by Acme, we can skip that occurrence. Aditya — can you confirm runtime availability for the demo VM on the Week 1 Tue slot and whether we should provision a dedicated GPU for a live run?

Thanks,
Marissa
Director, Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
